_comment: English edition (India) learning resources. Hand-checked: each URL was opened on 2026-11-07. This is a list of standing official resources, not a calendar of events.

meta.title: Learning resources for hospital AI governance in India
meta.description: Official guidance and consultation pages from CDSCO and ICMR that hospital administrators and compliance teams use to learn about AI and data protection.
meta.lead: There is no single official events calendar for hospital AI. Here are standing resources from official sources, each opened and checked.

notice: Standing resources, not scheduled events. Check each page for what it currently offers.

items.name: CDSCO public notices (consultations)
items.body: Draft guidance documents appear here for stakeholder comments. Reading a draft before it is final is a way to see where requirements are heading.
items.audience: Compliance, procurement and clinical engineering staff.

items.name: ICMR guidelines
items.body: Ethics guidance including the 2023 guidelines on AI in biomedical research and healthcare, whose Section 5 covers governance and which end with an ethics checklist (the guidelines page lists the document).

items.name: Medical Devices Rules, 2017
items.body: The full text of the Rules, the legal basis for how medical devices, including software, are classified and licensed.
